en: A vintage-tinted photograph of a mountainous forest landscape. In the foreground there is a rough dirt road or path with rocks and a small stone structure or spring beside it. Two people stand near the structure, one appearing to draw water. Dense conifer trees cover the slope behind them, and mountains rise in the distant background. Greek text is printed at the top, and a website credit appears at the bottom.
